BiblicalUsage: Matred is named as the mother of Mehetabel, the wife of Hadar the last king of Edom, and the daughter of Mezahab. Her name is kept in the record of Edom's kings, the line that stood against Israel from Esau's day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe her name matters because the Bible keeps the names of the mothers too, and the line of Edom is traced as carefully as the line of Israel, even when it stands against God's people.
